name: Commit and Push Button
description: Adds a button to the Source Control view title bar that dispatches a Claude agent to commit the currently-staged changes with a templated message and push to the current branch.

commitMessageFormat.label: Commit Message Format
commitMessageFormat.description: Single-line template the dispatched agent fills in when writing the commit message from the staged diff. Placeholders the agent substitutes: [TICKET] for the active ticket id if known, <type> for the change type (feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor), and <summary> for a concise description. Keep this on one line; multi-line templates lose their newlines when passed to the agent. Changing this changes how every future button-triggered commit is worded.
